criteria.requirement: Open to social entrepreneurs of any nationality, working in any country.
criteria.applicant: Citizen of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
criteria.quote: We welcome social entrepreneurs of any nationality, working in any country.

criteria.requirement: Working in any country (a non-U.S. base is allowed).
criteria.applicant: Resident of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (city not recorded).
criteria.quote: We welcome social entrepreneurs of any nationality, working in any country.

criteria.applicant: Bachelor's degree (Licence) in Business Administration, obtained in 2024.
criteria.quote: Are there any educational requirements? No.

criteria.requirement: Work that has already started (serving three people counts); incorporation is not needed.
criteria.applicant: No registered business recorded in the profile; whether any venture or social initiative has been started is not recorded.
criteria.missing: Whether the applicant has already started a social or business venture (the page says unstarted work is 'a not yet, not a no').
criteria.quote: We back unproven, unfunded, and unfinished work, but not unstarted work.

criteria.requirement: The applicant must be a founder or co-founder who started the work and still sets its direction.
criteria.applicant: No venture or founder role recorded in the profile.
criteria.missing: Whether the applicant founded a venture and still leads it.
criteria.quote: Do I need to be the founder? Yes. We back founders and co-founders, the people who started the work and still set its direction.

criteria.requirement: The Fellowship is described as full time.
criteria.applicant: No full-time employment recorded; availability for a full-time commitment is not recorded.
criteria.missing: Whether the applicant could work full time on their own venture during the Fellowship.
criteria.quote: Through our full-time Fellowship, we find people working on plans to make the world better in a big way.

criteria.requirement: No age limit is stated on the Talent Platform or Fellowship pages read.
No language requirement is stated on the pages read (the pages are in English).

funding.conditions: Seed funding described as a stipend over 18 months; for for-profit organisations it takes the form of recoverable grants; how it is paid and whether it goes to the founder or the venture are not stated.
funding.quote: A stipend over 18 months (100,000 USD). Funding offered to for-profit organizations is in the form of recoverable grants.

funding.conditions: Joining the Talent Platform is free; no fee is mentioned for the Fellowship itself on the pages read.
funding.quote: Does it cost anything? No. Membership is free.

out_of_pocket: None stated: joining the Talent Platform is free; the pages say nothing about who pays for travel to in-person convenings or other costs.

cycles.window_text: Members are invited to apply when the application opens; selection dates are to be announced in early 2027.
cycles.quote: Fellowship selection dates will be announced in early 2027.

cycles.window_text: Later intake windows are tentatively planned on a quarterly cadence, the next ones in July and October 2027; no dates are given.
cycles.quote: Subsequent windows are tentatively planned on a quarterly cadence, with the next ones in July and October 2027 respectively.
Request to join the Talent Platform by March 31, 2027 to be included in this first submission period.
